landing.hero_text: Build a living city, forge mighty armies and join forces with other rulers. Every decision shapes your shared world.
landing.real_alpha: Not a render. This is the alpha.
landing.rhythm: You do not jump between interchangeable menus. City, world and battle share one rhythm: prepare, decide and act together.

landing.world_calls_text: Secure resources, read the open paths and discover where your alliance needs you.
landing.march_begins_text: Choose troops, weigh the travel time and attack only when the commitment is right.
landing.real_footage: All footage comes from the current game build, with the real HUD, actual buildings and the current world map.
landing.world_caption: Read the map. Choose your path.
landing.plan_text: Your castle level alone does not decide a war. March times, supplies, specializations, defense and the right moment matter just as much.
landing.research_army_text: – develop clear strengths instead of starting everything at once.
landing.world_alliances_text: – share information, support allies and choose your battles.
landing.lore_intro: The Star Crown once held the realms in balance. When it shattered, ancient rulers awoke and seized their lands. Now young kingdoms must forge alliances, recover the lost crown shards and decide whether the world will be united again.
landing.lore_boss_one_text: A cursed guardian whose roots consume roads and villages.
landing.lore_boss_two_text: She hides a crown shard within her frozen palace.
landing.lore_boss_three_text: The mightiest ancient ruler waits beyond the gates of the Ashlands.
landing.lore_promise: Every boss is a shared chapter: discover, prepare, attack as an alliance and change the world through your victory.
landing.oath_text: Union of Kingdoms does not reward a lonely checklist. Your kingdom develops its own character through priorities, allies and the battles you deliberately fight or avoid.
landing.alpha_text: The alpha is a real playtest: systems are expanded, values adjusted and bugs fixed. Your feedback influences what Union of Kingdoms becomes.
landing.you_bring_text: A valid alpha key, a modern browser and an interest in honest feedback.
landing.expect_text: Unfinished content, balance changes, possible interruptions and, where technically necessary, progress resets.
landing.promise_text: No pay-to-win test, transparent changes and a game that grows together with its testers.
landing.access_text: Redeem your personal access once when creating your account. After that, your player name and password are enough to continue.
landing.key_once: Your key is checked securely and is not stored in plain text.
landing.choose_credentials: Choose a name and password for your game account.
landing.progress_saved: Your progress is automatically saved on the server.
landing.new_or_member: New here or already part of the alpha?
landing.faq_alpha_answer: Access is limited to invited testers. The game is already playable, but it is still actively expanded and balanced.
landing.faq_key: Do I need the alpha key every time I log in?
landing.faq_key_answer: No. You redeem it once when creating your account. After that, sign in with your player name and password.
landing.faq_download: Do I need to download anything?
landing.faq_download_answer: No. Union of Kingdoms runs directly in a modern browser and supports touch, portrait and landscape layouts.
landing.faq_offline: Does the world continue while I am offline?
landing.faq_offline_answer: Yes. Construction jobs, research and the shared world follow server time. You do not need to stay online.
landing.faq_reset_answer: During an alpha, a reset may be necessary when fundamental systems or data structures change. Such steps will be announced transparently.
landing.footer_text: A hand-drawn fantasy strategy game in active development.

copy.b16a2b0946b42d69: Union of Kingdoms is a fantasy strategy game about growing your city, building an army and finding your place in a shared world. The long-term vision brings together lasting progression, player-versus-player conquest and cooperative monster battles.
copy.03eb4d978c8d095d: Develop production, storage, buildings and research. Train stronger troops and shape your equipment around your next objective. Each improvement supports the next stage of your kingdom.
copy.51f3b7420e4a0641: Join alliance rallies against powerful monsters. The direction is an expanding series of tougher enemies and exciting rewards, giving your alliance new reasons to prepare, improve and fight together.
copy.aecf203b0e6ed165: The intended progression is ongoing, rather than a repeating seasonal restart. During development, alpha resets and balance changes are still possible.
copy.415d079f545607de: Three troop types. Ten tiers each.
copy.8ae5b12deff32036: Infantry, archers and cavalry each progress through ten tiers. Every type trains in its own building. Develop that building and your city centre to unlock stronger troops, then strengthen your kingdom through research.
copy.430bfe21b907efdc: The current infantry artwork: a guardian with a blue shield and hammer
copy.72451a570a94198f: Build the core of your army. Compare attack, defence, health and carrying capacity before choosing the troops for a march. The new guardian artwork gives infantry its shield-bearing identity.
copy.d2927bb5f1d3d6c3: The current archer artwork: a white-haired archer with a red hood and flaming arrow
copy.107906dc79aaa498: Develop your ranged troops alongside the rest of the army. Their equipment progresses from bows to crossbows as you unlock higher tiers.
copy.b180433eb40ce188: The current cavalry artwork: a violet shadow rider on an antlered mount
copy.5998ad5bb6a71931: Examples of the updated relic artwork
copy.1e3adc544d6986d2: Bring mounted troops into your formations. Consider march speed, carrying capacity and the strength needed at the destination. The shadow rider is the new cavalry appearance.
copy.df67c704eb293057: Train, unlock higher tiers and promote eligible troops. Treat wounded units in the hospital and use suitable speedups on active orders.
copy.4e3c557351ae5ac0: Make your inventory part of the strategy.
copy.8ecabcc5933bfb92: Items support the choices you make: building, researching, training, healing, gathering and preparing for battle. Check each item's effect and requirements before using it.
copy.ccee3f9554d7e55e: Resource packs provide supplies when used. General and specialised speedups shorten eligible active orders. Keep your next construction, research or army goal in mind when deciding what to spend.
copy.d87d9359eb875f39: Temporary boosts support specific activities. Open chests, collect fragments and use teleporters when their requirements are met. Check the in-game details for each item’s effect and availability.
copy.c6a2163fd6bab71e: Collect fragments, exchange matching-rarity universal fragments and develop the relic effects that fit your objective. The treasury offers up to six equipment slots, unlocked as it grows, and five saved loadouts. Equipped relics determine your active bonuses.
copy.8ba72640e4f32951: Harvest horn filled with grain and fruit
copy.348219fe816fcc5c: Discover the updated storybook relic artwork. The in-game catalogue shows each relic’s current effects, requirements and values.
copy.d65aeb9832201d14: From a small city to a powerful alliance.
copy.2f97caaa1397f353: The central loop is simple: prepare, act, earn rewards and reinvest. The decisions become more demanding as your kingdom grows.
copy.dfae1ff2330a80e8: Produce food, wood, stone and gold. Expand your storage and meet building prerequisites. A strong economy keeps construction, research and training moving.
copy.d8bb70b52514ed27: Upgrade the city centre and training buildings to unlock higher troop tiers. Research useful bonuses. Balance new recruits, promotions and hospital needs against your available resources.
copy.3a3d2632526f2e31: Gather resources and choose suitable monster targets. Compare the army you can send with the risks, travel time and possible rewards. Read reports and use the results to improve the next march.
copy.f0eeae690057a229: Join an alliance, share information and help coordinate objectives. Your own progress gives you more ways to contribute to the group, while cooperation makes larger challenges possible.
copy.fe1587b5f6dd819b: For rival players, scouting and timing matter. For rally monsters, assemble with your alliance and commit suitable forces. These are different risks and objectives, supported by the same economy and army.
copy.4924b37628ef3c3d: Turn rewards into the next step
copy.6019026aae78f2a0: Use earned supplies, useful items and relic progress to strengthen your kingdom. The long-term aim is to compete for kingdom control and keep facing more powerful monsters together as the game expands.
copy.6aac1f8fc4e1fcc6: Grumwald, Frostgrimm, Sandmaul and Glutramm are integrated rally enemies, with ten levels per regional monster. Assemble your alliance and prepare together. Battle rewards depend on the target and the current reward tables.
copy.2b8103f7c74cdf0a: The road to the full game.
copy.f6c3a50386844368: The alpha is a working foundation, not the finished destination. Features, visuals, balance and progression are still evolving.
copy.cc7ee2a51bd8d8c9: City development, research, three troop types through T10, inventory, relic loadouts, gathering, player combat and alliance rallies are implemented in the current project. Availability follows world settings and alpha access.
copy.04fe689517dcaeee: Continue refining the everyday game loop, combat balance, rewards and alliance coordination. Develop kingdom conquest and expand the ladder of cooperative monster challenges. Exact conquest rules and future reward tiers are not final.
copy.9abcb7f8f975fbdf: Is this a seasonal game with regular restarts?
copy.b31774c72ebaf8d9: Is the Star Crown story the endgame?
copy.c068c931d20ae6c6: The Star Crown is an earlier story concept, not a confirmed playable campaign or a fixed seasonal ending. The confirmed direction is ongoing development, kingdom conquest and stronger cooperative monster challenges.

intro.welcome.title: Your kingdom awaits
intro.welcome.text: Welcome, my lord. This village is the beginning of your realm. I will help you find your footing. You can skip this introduction and return to it from the Beginner guide at any time.
intro.city.title: Give your people a strong home
intro.city.text: Tap a building to see its purpose and next upgrade. Farms, lumber camps, quarries and gold mines supply your plans. Your castle opens the way to a stronger city. Check the cost and confirm each action yourself.
intro.quests.title: A little progress, every day
intro.quests.text: Follow the main quests to develop your kingdom. Daily quests offer fresh goals and rewards. Open Quests to see your progress and claim completed rewards. The timer shows when the daily quests reset.
intro.together.title: A wider world is waiting
intro.together.text: Events show the adventures currently available in your world and their remaining time. Find allies, help each other and prepare for larger challenges together. The Beginner guide will now help you choose your first goal.
